Summary table of characteristics by group

Source: R/summaries.R
phw_summary_table.Rd

The "Table 1" of a report: counts and percentages for categorical variables (age group, sex, risk factors...) and a median (IQR) or mean (SD) for numeric ones, optionally split by a grouping variable with a total column. Render it with phw_flextable() or phw_reactable(): variable names become bold headings with their levels indented, and the grouping variable becomes a header spanning its columns.

Usage

phw_summary_table(
  data,
  vars = NULL,
  by = NULL,
  labels = list(),
  percent = c("column", "row", "none"),
  numeric = c("median_iqr", "mean_sd"),
  total = TRUE,
  missing = "Unknown",
  digits = 1,
  n_in_header = TRUE,
  label_header = "Characteristic"
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with one row per person (or case, episode...).

vars

Columns to summarise, chosen as in dplyr::select(), e.g. c(age_group, sex) or starts_with("sym"). Defaults to every column except by.

by

Optional column to split by (e.g. outcome or year), unquoted as in dplyr. A string works too.

labels

Named list of display names, e.g. list(age_group = "Age group"). Variable label attributes are used otherwise.

percent

For categorical variables, percentages of each "column" (the default), of each "row", or "none".

numeric

How to summarise numeric variables: "median_iqr" or "mean_sd".

total

Add a total column when by is given?

missing

Label for missing values, or NULL to leave them out.

digits

Decimal places for percentages and statistics.

n_in_header

Show "(n = ...)" under each column heading?

label_header

Heading of the first column.

Value

A phw_summary data frame.

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  age_group = sample(c("0-14", "15-44", "45-64", "65+"), 200, TRUE),
  sex = sample(c("Female", "Male", NA), 200, TRUE, prob = c(.49, .49, .02)),
  days = rpois(200, 6),
  group = sample(c("Group A", "Group B"), 200, TRUE)
)
tab <- phw_summary_table(df, by = group,
                         labels = list(age_group = "Age group", sex = "Sex",
                                       days = "Days"))
tab
#>  Characteristic Group A (n = 103) Group B (n = 97)  Total (n = 200)
#>       Age group                                                    
#>            0-14        26 (25.2%)       29 (29.9%)       55 (27.5%)
#>           15-44        26 (25.2%)       29 (29.9%)       55 (27.5%)
#>           45-64        25 (24.3%)       12 (12.4%)       37 (18.5%)
#>             65+        26 (25.2%)       27 (27.8%)       53 (26.5%)
#>             Sex                                                    
#>          Female        49 (47.6%)       51 (52.6%)      100 (50.0%)
#>            Male        49 (47.6%)       42 (43.3%)       91 (45.5%)
#>         Unknown          5 (4.9%)         4 (4.1%)         9 (4.5%)
#>            Days  6.0 (4.0 to 8.0) 6.0 (5.0 to 8.0) 6.0 (4.0 to 8.0)
#> n (%); median (IQR) 
if (requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE)) phw_flextable(tab)
